comments.body: What makes you profitable in trade automation? How much time/effort it took to get this auto trader profitable

replies.author: Yinnebecivil
replies.body:
3 years of prop firms, back & forward testing before making it public last year. Just because of this won’t guarantee your success. Understanding the markets and building the algorithm to that level is not easy however it can be done. 

Once it was public from August 25th last year, it has been profitable each month and it’s nearly the 1 year mark since then. It’s gone through various market conditions and has been able to adapt to each phase and now it’s just about building on this and growing more. 

The goal is to bring as many like minded individuals to work with us and invest to a system that acts as like the S&P 500 but with compressed time as the focus is compound growth & capital preservation. I’ve collaborated with other automated systems before and they have never survived. Once me and my team brought this out it has stood strong.
